name: local-copilot-chat
description: Copilot Chat with seamless switching between local AI models like Qwen and DeepSeek

localCopilot.ollamaEndpoint.description: Base URL for the local Ollama API

localCopilot.defaultModel.description: Default local model to use on startup

localCopilot.numCtx.description: Context window size in tokens allocated to Ollama (num_ctx)

localCopilot.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for conversational responses (tool calling enforces a deterministic 0.1 ceiling)

localCopilot.maxTurns.description: Maximum tool execution turns permitted for agent tasks

localCopilot.connectTimeout.description: Connection establishment timeout to Ollama in milliseconds

localCopilot.idleStreamTimeout.description: Stream inactivity timeout in milliseconds before a stalled generation is stopped

localCopilot.totalGenerationTimeout.description: Total generation turn timeout in milliseconds

localCopilot.modelUnloadPolicy.description: VRAM management policy: 'keepAlive' (default 5m), 'unloadImmediately' (freed right after turn), or 'unloadOnIdle' (timer-based)

localCopilot.modelKeepAliveDuration.description: Duration to keep model in VRAM when using keepAlive policy (e.g. '5m', '10m', '0')

localCopilot.idleUnloadTimeout.description: Idle duration in milliseconds before unloading model when unloadOnIdle policy is active

localCopilot.context.warnOnCpuOffload.description: Warn when partial CPU offloading of model KV cache or layers is detected from Ollama

localCopilot.router.enabled.description: Enable swap-cost aware ModelRouter to automatically switch models based on task intent and measured profiles (ships OFF by default)

localCopilot.benchmark.repetitions.description: Number of statistical repetitions (N >= 3) executed per benchmark task for variance control

localCopilot.agent.enableStructuredEditF.description: Enable structured-edit fallback protocol (CREATE, SEARCH/REPLACE, DELETE_FILE) for models that lack native tool-calling support in Ollama

localCopilot.agent.suggestAgentModeOnEdi.description: Display a visible non-modal suggestion banner to switch to Agent Mode when an edit or implement intent is detected in Chat Mode

localCopilot.agent.minExplorationBeforeA.description: Minimum distinct read-only exploration calls (list_dir, view_file_range, search_workspace) required before ask_user gate allows clarification questions

localCopilot.agent.maxClarificationQuest.description: Maximum number of user clarification questions allowed per agent task session

localCopilot.agent.enableWorkspaceDiscov.description: Run bounded deterministic workspace discovery (file tree, tech stacks, manifests, git status) before the first agent planning turn

localCopilot.tools.stream.description: Enable streaming tool calls for low Time-to-First-Byte (TTFB) responsiveness and progressive thinking feedback

localCopilot.tools.enableEmbeddedFallbac.description: Allow strict single-call embedded tool extraction fallback only for models probed as embedded-style when native tool calls are empty. User-scoped only (cannot be enabled by workspace settings).

localCopilot.timeouts.headersTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for receiving HTTP response headers / first byte from Ollama

localCopilot.roleModels.description: Explicit per-role model overrides (e.g. {"coder": "qwen2.5-coder:7b", "planner": "deepseek-r1:8b"}). When not set for a role, the user's pinned model is used across all roles.

localCopilot.agent.disableThinking.description: Disable the model thinking phase (<think>) during agent turns if supported by Ollama via think: false.

localCopilot.timeouts.absoluteMaxTimeout.description: Absolute ceiling in milliseconds for generation, after which requests abort regardless of extensions.

localCopilot.timeouts.keepGoingGracePeri.description: Grace period in milliseconds to wait for user 'Keep going' confirmation before aborting when total ceiling is reached.

localCopilot.context.maxPriorTurns.description: Number of prior conversation turns to supply verbatim to the agent orchestrator.

localCopilot.context.tokenBudget.description: Character budget for prior conversation context supplied to the agent orchestrator.

localCopilot.context.enableLlmSummary.description: Enable LLM-based summarization of turns older than maxPriorTurns instead of deterministic summarization.

localCopilot.agent.decomposeMultiPhaseSp.description: Automatically decompose large multi-phase specifications into isolated sequential tasks, executing and verifying only Phase 1 per turn.

localCopilot.agent.enforceFileWritesForI.description: Reject code-dump text completions when implementation intent was requested without any corresponding file write tool calls.

scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run compile:test && node out-test/test/integration/runTest.js
